reviews.title: Poor subscription policies and unhelpful customer support
reviews.text:
I was a frequent user of this app for a long time, but my recent experience with Premium cancellation and customer support was extremely disappointing.

As soon as my subscription ended, all my saved lists were instantly locked without any prior warning. I wasn't even given the chance to consolidate my routes into a single list before losing access. To make matters worse, customer support completely refused to help and simply pointed out that I have to pay again just to get my own data back. Holding user data hostage is an awful UX practice that completely destroys trust.

On top of that, user-generated routes are often unreliable due to a lack of route verification - many tracks lead straight into completely overgrown paths where no human has walked in years.

I used to love this app, but holding my saved lists behind a paywall and unhelpful support gave me every reason to switch to competitors.

reviews.title: Solo con datos/wifi
reviews.text: Aunque te descargues los mapas y la ruta, te quedas sin la opción de trazar rutas sino tienes red. Además solo permite hacer la ruta en la dirección del track original. Peak finder era una aplicación muy exacta y versátil,pero aquí los perfiles no se adecúan, vuelves a necesitar internet y no te permite revisar perfiles en fotos con ubicación.  Además cada vez que la abres te salta el aviso de “quita el modo avión o conéctate a wifi” tan difícil sería un botón para decirle que estoy offline y voy a estarlo hasta que me de la gana?
